analyst_view.overall: Slovan Bratislava are bottom of the league phase with no points, 1 goal scored and 17 conceded in four games. Betis are 11th on 9 points and drew 1-1 in the Seville derby on Saturday, conceding a stoppage-time equaliser after a goalkeeping error by Alvaro Valles; Pellegrini had called the derby the priority and did not rule out rotation for this trip. Dani Ceballos and Jose Morante are out for Betis, which the numbers already count. News on Slovan's squad was thin in what I could find; the numbers blend their domestic games into their ratings, so they may overrate how often Slovan create chances at this level. No referee has been named.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, including about 1.0 for Slovan, who have scored once in four Champions League games. Betis come off a draining derby three days earlier and may rotate, and Ceballos's absence is already counted. I go a little lower, to about 3.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, with Betis around 6.1 and their busy recent corner counts already in (+3%). Betis should still dominate the ball even with some rotation, and Slovan defend deep, so I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, which reflects Slovan's usual card rate when under pressure. No referee is named, and nothing in the news points to a more heated or calmer game than usual. I stay at 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.8 shots and add about 10% to Betis for how much Slovan concede. Slovan's own shooting at this level has been thin, and a partly rotated Betis after the derby may play at a slower tempo. I trim to about 30.8.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target, including a 6% boost for Betis. With Slovan rarely testing goalkeepers in this competition and Betis possibly rotating, I go to about 10.1.
